policy: Only the ten listed, already-inspected sources are in the foundational subset. Modern institutional prose is linked and paraphrased; only explicitly supported public-domain editions retain that status.
rightsRule: A linkable modern source is not treated as public domain unless its recorded rights status explicitly says so.

sources.name: Mourt's Relation or Journal of the Plantation at Plymouth
sources.citation: William Bradford and Edward Winslow, Mourt's Relation, 1622; Henry Martyn Dexter ed., Boston: J. K. Wiggin, 1865, Library of Congress LCCN 03008746.
locatorsInspected: Library of Congress item metadata and rights statement
1865 edition, pp. 5-6 (Mayflower Compact introduction and text)
1621 harvest account as reproduced in the edition
sources.limitations: English colonial account published partly to report and promote the plantation; the inspected object is an 1865 edition of the 1622 printing, not the lost manuscripts behind it.
sources.notes: A machine-assisted pilot dataset awaiting further historical, editorial, and tribal review. Access and limitations are recorded in the source register.
sources.corpusUse: Metadata, short original SourceRoot paraphrases, and bounded locators only.
